rows.information: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malviya Cancer Centre, Varanasi

content_sections.heading: About SBC Exports Ltd.
content_sections.text: M/s. SBC Exports Ltd. describes itself in the notice as an outsourcing agency for the supply of manpower services, on contract basis, to HBCH and MPMMCC, Varanasi. The selected candidate will be deployed at these cancer care institutions in Varanasi.

content_sections.heading: SBC Exports Ltd. Tutor (Operation Theatre Techniques) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: 35 years, as on the last date of application. Essential education and experience: B.Sc. in Operation Theatre Technique or equivalent from a recognized university with 01-year experience. Valid email ID: Every applicant must have one, as the agency corresponds with candidates by email only. Internal candidates: They need to submit an NOC from their current HOD/OIC/Principal Investigator. Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of this post before applying.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Screening: Candidates are first screened on the basis of the information they give in the online application form. Interview: Screened candidates are called for interview, and the date is sent by email to eligible candidates only. The agency reserves the right not to call any candidates for interview, without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment will be initially for a period of six months. It may be extended further depending upon the performance of the candidate and the requirement of the institute. Accommodation will not be provided to outstation candidates. If any shortcoming is detected even after appointment, the services of the candidate are liable to be terminated forthwith.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SBC Exports Ltd. Tutor (Operation Theatre Techniques) Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the online application form . Candidature is accepted through this route only. Fill in every detail correctly, as incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Enter an email ID that is valid and that you check, including its spam or bulk mail folder. Submit the form before the deadline. If called for interview, carry the documents listed below. Documents to carry to the interview: Original documents supporting the date of birth given in the online form Original documents supporting qualifications Original documents supporting experience Any other original documents supporting the details furnished in the form Candidates who do not carry these originals will not be allowed to appear for the interview.

faq.question: Q1. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a contract post, initially for six months, and any extension depends on the candidate's performance and the institute's requirement.

faq.question: Q2. Who will employ the selected candidate?
faq.answer: The notice is issued by M/s. SBC Exports Ltd., the outsourcing agency that supplies manpower to HBCH and MPMMCC, Varanasi. The vacancy is for deployment at these institutions.

faq.question: Q3. How will I know my interview date?
faq.answer: The date will come by email, and only eligible candidates will receive it. The agency is not responsible for emails lost because of a wrong ID or delivered to spam.

faq.question: Q4. Can I apply by post or in person?
faq.answer: No. Candidates must apply through the online application only, using the Google Form link printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q5. What must internal candidates submit?
faq.answer: Internal candidates need to submit an NOC from their current HOD, OIC or Principal Investigator.

faq.question: Q6. Will accommodation be given to candidates from outside Varanasi?
faq.answer: No. The notice tells all outstation candidates that accommodation will not be provided.

faq.question: Q7. What happens if I give incorrect information?
faq.answer: Candidature will be cancelled at any stage of recruitment if a candidate is found ineligible, or has given incorrect, false or incomplete information or suppressed a material fact.
